en: (Well, at least he's not laughing anymore.)
One day I was taking a family to their new apartment. They had a dog with them. He was really cute.
Uh-huh. And?
But it turns out the place they were moving to didn't allow pets. So they decided to get one of their old neighbors to take him in.
But the dog chased after the taxi. He just kept on running and running.
Aww, that's a nice story. I have a soft spot for animals myself. Very moving.
(At least that stopped his laughing.)
Yeah? Ahah... What? Ahahah.
You better stop laughing at me. Or else.
No need to growl at me like that, though. Now you've gone and ruined my good mood.
(He stopped laughing, but doesn't look happy.)
(I wonder if he's sobered up and settled down.)
Ngh... *sniffle*
(He's crying.)
I... I'm just a good-for-nothing waste of space at work...
(He's gone from a laughing drunk to a crying drunk.)
And at home, my one and only daughter hates me. She used to be my little girl, but not anymore.
She just complains that I'm dirty all the time. What am I going to do?
If she thinks you're dirty, why don't you just bathe more often?
But I bathe every day!
That doesn't stop her complaining, though. I guess she just despises me. It's a real sad situation... *sniffle*
(That didn't seem to help.)
Why don't you give her a good scolding?
If I did that, she'd only hate me more.
That might be true now, but one day she'll understand that you were only doing it for her own good.
Yes. You're a good father, who works hard to support his family.
You ought to sit her down and let her know that what she's doing is wrong. You need to exert your authority as a father.
My authority as a father, huh? Yeah... Better to scold her than try to curry favor.
Wow. I'm feeling a lot better now. Thank you!
(That seems to have cheered him up.)
All girls are like that in their teens.
Really!? I never knew!
I guess every guy with a daughter goes through the same thing then, huh?
I believe many do, yes.
No kidding. It's kind of reassuring to know I'm not in this alone. I feel a bit better.
(He seems a bit happier now.)
(I wonder if he's sobered up yet.)
When the car sways like this, it really makes my head swim.
*hic* *hic*
(What comes after the laughter and crying?)
Hey, driver!
You were making fun of me just then, weren't you!? You better stop that right now!
(Now he's looking for a fight.)
I wasn't making fun of you.
Don't lie to me! You think I'm a corporate slave, don't you!?
You see me as a servant to my company! Just some rank and file pencil pusher, right!?
It seems to me you're the one who sees yourself that way.
You should carry yourself with more confidence.
Gah! Shut your mouth! My company would get along just fine without me.
You may be right.
See, you think the same thing!
But forget your company. What about your family?
Without you, your family would fall apart. You're working to provide for them, right?
I think that alone makes it all worth it.
Driver...
You're right. It doesn't matter what they say at work. I have a family to look after. I should do my job with my head held high.
(That seemed to encourage him. He's calmer now.)
Well, I've only just met you, so I don't know enough to make that sort of judgment.
Well, if you knew me, that's what you'd think.
It's true. Everybody sees me as a total waste of space.
(I need to encourage him somehow.)
I'm sure your coworkers don't think that.
How can you know that?
You just told me you don't know anything about me because we just met! You don't have a clue!
I appreciate that you're trying to cheer me up, though. Thanks.
(It looks like he calmed down. I wish I could have given him some encouragement, though.)
(It sounds like he wants me to agree with him, so I guess I will.)
Yes, you don't exactly look like you're going places.
What did you just say!? Don't pretend you know anything about me, man!
(I should have thought more before answering.)
Sorry about snapping at you there. I may be drunk, but that's no excuse.
Here's the fare, and a tip for the trouble.
No, thank you. I hope I'm sober next time we meet!
I hope I'm sober next time we meet.
Man. I was in good spirits earlier. Now I feel terrible... Here's your money.
To Hawaii, please. And stick to the local roads, won't you?
Hah! I'm just kidding, of course. Don't mind me, I just like to get a rise out of people.
(This could be a long ride...)
Okay. Please get in.
Ready or not, here I come! Hah! I'm so zany.
Whew, it's so exhausting talking to guys like you. Just kidding! Thanks for the fun ride!
(At least the customer looked pretty happy.)
Thanks for chatting with me, driver!
(At least the customer looked happy.)
I know I get on people's nerves, but I wish we could have talked a bit more.
(I guess I could have been a bit more welcoming. Dealing with customers is tough.)
<Color:22>Nagasu Boulevard<Color:Default>, please. I'm in a hurry to meet one of my clients.
Thank you! So, I have a confession to make.
I'm actually a driving examiner.
A driving examiner?
Yes, and your driving skills are absolutely amazing!
Thank you. But I have a confession to make.
Yes. Your driving skills are good, but I think you still have room for improvement.
I think you should really work on your driving skills.
Right. Sorry about that.
Let me in! I need you to take me to a client, and fast! I'll navigate while you drive!
(Looks like she's in a hurry.)
Okay, go straight. No, right! Then take a left!
(She's going to get us killed.)
Come on, move it!
(Why is she in such a rush? Is she late for a meeting or something?)
Hey, are you listening to me!? You need to step on it!
Uh-oh! I think we missed a turn.
Oof... I never met a taxi driver who could fight like that.
I told you we should stop doing this!
It's just mean to do this as a way to cover the theater costs.
I guess we should stick to acting.
Sorry, man. We're all just struggling actors at a little theater. We didn't have the money to pay the upkeep, so we turned to this...
We'll change our ways and build up the troupe again!
I really apologize for all this. Here's the fare, and a tip to show how sorry we are.
We won't try anything stupid like this again. Promise!
Well, they say they're sorry. Are you gonna give them a pass?
Yes. And thank you for speaking up.
No need for thanks. I've got lots of time on my hands these days. I'm happy to help out.
If you lot really wanna be successful actors, you'd better not try any more monkey business like this.
(That old man saved the day. I'll have to keep an eye out for schemes like this.)
Are you okay!?
Ow ow ow. I think I... broke something...
Hey! He looks pretty bad!
(Hmm. Something's up. It didn't feel like I hit him.)
Hey, are you okay?
This taxi drove right into me, at a very high speed!
On this little road? Was the driver crazy!?
Hold on. I admit I was going fast, but I'm sure I stopped in time.
How can we be sure of that? Let's see what your passenger has to say.
Yeah. So, what happened?
The driver hit him, I'm certain of it!
I was telling him to please slow down and drive safely, but he just kept on speeding!
Look, normally I'd go straight to the police with this, but I don't want to ruin your life.
If your license got revoked, you wouldn't be able to make a living, right? We could just settle this right here, if you want.
That is so kind of you, given such unusual circumstances.
Hey, man, you're lucky you hit someone willing to give you a break!
How about you compensate me 500,000 yen to cover my medical bills, and then we can pretend this never happened?
Wow! You're getting off so lightly!
Come on, let's do this quickly. If you don't have money on you, there's an ATM just around that⑬
Wait just a minute!
I saw the whole thing from my window. That taxi driver never hit you, he braked in plenty of time.
Who the hell's this guy?
He's not with us.
What, some old guy just happened to be watching from the window of his home? I don't believe it!
I've actually been watching all of you for a while. You were acting suspicious.
I saw you hiding out along the road. What exactly are you up to?
Uh-oh...
Wait a minute... You're scammers, aren't you!?
The passenger, the victim, and the passersby. You were all in on it, huh? Crafty bastards.
Fine, you got us. But now we've got a problem, see? We can't afford to let you squeal!
Looks like we better persuade you to keep your mouth shut.
Please, let me handle this.
I appreciate it. Come on, young lady.
Even better! No need to hold back, let's maul this guy!
(Looks like a foreign tourist.)
Please go to <Color:22>Meisei Street<Color:Default>!
Do you speak Japanese?
Yes! But just... Just a little!
(A little, huh?)
Fukuoka is great! The food, delicious!
What did you eat?
Hmm. The name, I forget.
Well, what was in it?
Spicy... red eggs!
Spicy red eggs? Hmm, that must be...
(Spicy, huh?)
Was it karashi takana? Spicy mustard greens?
Nooo! Fish eggs!
Fish eggs? Karashi mentaiko, perhaps? Spicy cod roe?
Yes! Karashi mentaiko! Very, very delicious. Number one favorite!
(I'm glad I could clear that up.)
(Eggs, huh?)
Was it onsen tamago? Hot spring eggs?
No! Different! Oh, I remember! The name was karashi mentaiko!
I see. That's spicy red eggs, all right. Spicy cod roe.
Why could you not guess? Aren't you Japanese?
(I should have given that more thought.)
(Hmm, what eggs are spicy and red?)
Was it called karashi mentaiko? Spicy cod roe?
People in Fukuoka often say "bari."
(They do use that a lot around here when they want to stress something.)
Please tell me what "bari" means! In English!
("Bari" in English, huh?)
It's a local term they use to emphasize things. So I guess you'd say "very" in English.
I see! So "bari" is "very"! Easy to remember!
Hey, you! Thank you "bari" much!
(Heh. Looks like he gets it.)
I guess "bari" means something like "special."
Special?
(That might not be quite the right nuance.)
Actually, it's probably closer to "very."
(I'm glad he got it.)
"Bari" means "let's go."
Huh!? Let's go? I do not get it.
Uh... Well, "bari" is used for emphasis. I guess in English you'd say...
"Very"?
Yeah, that's it. Very.
Hey! Why am I teaching you?
(I guess I need to brush up on my English.)
I want to get a tattoo with Chinese characters. Tell me a cool phrase, yeah?
A Chinese character tattoo, huh? You should get one that actually means something, instead of just picking one that looks good. What do you want it to say?
Hm. I like to live life to the fullest.
(Living life to the fullest, huh? Let's see... What Japanese phrase would convey that?)
How about "Ichiju Issai"?
What is the meaning?
It's when you have one soup, and one other dish with it. A simple meal.
What!? Why put that on my body!? Ugh, I will ask another for advice.
How about "Ichigo Ichie"?
It means you should treasure every encounter.
Good! I guess it is like you and me!
I've decided! I'll get an "Ichigo Ichie" tattoo! Thank you!
(That went over well.)
How about "Yakiniku Teishoku"?
Hmm... What is the meaning?
Well, it's usually grilled meat, with rice and soup on the side.
And you think... that makes a good tattoo?
Er, yes?
(I should have given that some more thought.)
Thank you "bari" much! You are a good driver!
Goodbye!
Thank you! You are a good driver! Here is the money.
You should work on being more global minded.
Good luck. Bye.
(I guess passengers from overseas can be tricky to deal with.)
Can you take me to <Color:22>Ose Bridge<Color:Default>?
(She's not exactly dressed for the weather.)
Oh dear...
I got stood up for a date.
I even bought this outfit specifically for today, but it was all for nothing.
Say, driver?
I don't suppose you could take me on a date?
What? You mean now?
Yes. I won't take much of your time. Just walk with me a little, okay?
Okay, I'll take you on a date.
You really will? Thanks, driver!
I'm sorry, but I can't do that.
You take your job pretty seriously, huh? Or do you just not want to be seen with me?
Hmph. I guess I'm not all that attractive, am I?
I'm sure deep down you think I'm an ugly witch.
Yeah, yeah. Nobody ever gives me the time of day. I'm so lonely.
Maybe I'll just throw myself out of this taxi and get it over with.
(Geez. I'd better do something.)
The doors have safety locks on them, so you can't open them from the inside.
Oh, I was only joking about that part.
